title: Discovery of Chromane-6-Sulfonamide Derivative as a Potent, Selective, and Orally Available Novel Retinoic Acid Receptor-Related Orphan Receptor gammat Inverse Agonist.
authors: Chen, Lei; Su, Mei; Jin, Qiu; Wang, Wei; Wang, Chun-Gu; Assani, Israa; Wang, Mu-Xuan; Zhao, Shi-Feng; Lv, Shen-Min; Wang, Jia-Wei; Sun, Bo; Li, Yan; Liao, Zhi-Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文报道RORγt小分子反向激动剂的合成与药理学评价，虽涉及转录因子但聚焦药物化学而非蛋白-DNA互作建模，仅含简单对接分析，与课题核心无关。
abstract: Interleukin-17 (IL-17) is a proinflammatory cytokine that plays a dominant role in inflammation, autoimmunity, and host defense. RORgammat is a key transcription factor mediating T helper 17 (Th17) cell differentiation and IL-17 production, which is able to activate CD8(+) T cells and elicit antitumor efficacy. A series of sulfonamide derivatives as novel RORgammat inverse agonists were designed and synthesized. Using GSK2981278 (phase II) as a starting point, we engineered structural modifications that significantly improved the activity and pharmacokinetic profile. In animal studies, oral administration of compound d3 showed a robust and dose-dependent inhibition of the IL-17A cytokine expression in a mouse imiquimod-induced skin inflammation model. Docking analysis of the binding mode revealed that the compound d3 occupied the active pocket suitably. Thus, compound d3 was selected as a clinical compound for the treatment of Th17-driven autoimmune diseases.
abstract_zh: 白细胞介素-17（Interleukin-17, IL-17）是一种促炎细胞因子，在炎症、自身免疫及宿主防御中发挥主导作用。RORgammat是介导辅助性T细胞17（T helper 17, Th17）分化及IL-17产生的关键转录因子，能够激活CD8(+) T细胞并引发抗肿瘤效应。本研究设计并合成了一系列磺酰胺衍生物作为新型RORgammat反向激动剂。以GSK2981278（II期）为起点，我们进行了结构修饰，显著改善了其活性及药代动力学特性。在动物实验中，口服化合物d3在小鼠咪喹莫特诱导的皮肤炎症模型中显示出对IL-17A细胞因子表达的强效且剂量依赖性抑制。对接分析结合模式表明，化合物d3适当地占据了活性口袋。因此，化合物d3被选为治疗Th17驱动的自身免疫性疾病的临床候选化合物。
